//: Tabled uses FIRESTORE, not the Realtime Database. They are different
products, both have a 'Rules' tab in the console, and their rule languages
are not interchangeable: Firestore rules are the rules_version/service DSL,
Realtime Database rules are JSON. Pasting one into the other's editor gives
'Line 1: Parse error' with no further explanation.
The database.rules.json below exists only to hold the unused Realtime
Database instance shut. Nothing in the app reads or writes it.

headers.//: The app shell must never be cached — routing is hash-based, so a stale index.html serves stale ?v= stamps and every JS file with it.
Everything else is cache-busted by its ?v= query string, so it can be cached hard.
